title: The Sky That Started Spinning
intro: This quiz follows Maya and Leo as they learn how tornadoes form and what to do during a tornado warning.

questions.prompt: What weather changes did Maya and Leo notice before the tornado warning?
choices: The sky became clear and cold
Dark clouds appeared, the air felt warm and sticky, and a cool gust rushed past
Snow began falling quickly
The Sun became unusually bright
questions.explanation: Dark clouds appeared, the air felt warm and sticky, and a cool gust rushed past.

choices: A large ocean wave
A spinning column of air stretching from a storm cloud toward the ground
A cloud that produces only rain
A strong wind that always moves in a straight line
questions.explanation: A tornado is a spinning column of air stretching from a storm cloud toward the ground.

questions.prompt: How can air begin to rotate inside a thunderstorm?
choices: Warm and cool air remain completely still
Winds blow in different directions or at different speeds
The Sun pulls the clouds downward
Rain freezes inside the cloud
questions.explanation: Air can begin to rotate when winds blow in different directions or at different speeds.

questions.prompt: Where did the class go during the tornado warning?
choices: Outside to watch the storm
Beside the classroom windows
To an inside hallway away from windows
To the school playground
questions.explanation: The class went to an inside hallway away from windows.

questions.prompt: What important lesson did Maya and Leo learn?
choices: Tornado warnings can be ignored when the rain is light
Tornadoes form only during winter
Learning about weather and following safety instructions helps protect people
The safest place during a tornado is near a window
questions.explanation: Learning about weather and following safety instructions helps protect people.
